sourceText:
Healthy Apple Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, March 24, 2010 - 12:50am

Ingredients




2 cups White Whole Wheat Flour
1/4 cup Wheat Germ
2 teaspoons baking soda
1 teaspoon cinnamon
1 teaspoon sea salt
1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
4 cups diced, peeled, tart cooking apples
3/4 cup turbinado sugar
3/4 packed brown sugar
1/2 applesauce (natural)
1 cup chopped walnuts
Eggs beaters to equal (2 eggs)
1 teaspoon vanilla
4 cups strawberries frozen or fresh
1/4 cup honey
1/4 cup turbinado sugar

Preparation

1 Stir together flour, wheat germ, soda, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg, set aside. 2 In large bowl combine apples, sugars, applesauce, walnuts, egg beaters and vanilla. Add flour mixture; stir gently with wooden spoon to blend well. 3 Turn into greased 13x9x2 inch baking pan. Bake in preheated 350 oven 50 minutes or until cake pulls away from sides of pan. Cool on wire rack. 4 Sprinkle with sifted confectioners sugar or pour strawberry sauce over warm cake. 5 Strawberry Sauce:Puree in blender until smooth 6 Stay Well!
